WITH color_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(p.product_color, 'No Color') as color,
    SUM(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as total_quantity
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.product_color, 'No Color')
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(total_quantity) as overall_quantity,
    AVG(total_quantity) as avg_quantity_per_color
  FROM color_totals
),
filtered_colors AS (
  SELECT 
    ct.total_quantity,
    ct.total_quantity / os.overall_quantity as share,
    ct.total_quantity - os.avg_quantity_per_color as excess
  FROM color_totals ct
  CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
  WHERE ct.total_quantity > os.avg_quantity_per_color
)
SELECT 
  AVG(total_quantity) as average_quantity,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(excess) as average_excess
FROM filtered_colors
